karty.priklad: Mae e'n gorwedd dan flanced ar y soffa.
karty.priklad_cs: He's lying under a blanket on the sofa (blanced → [f]lanced after dan).
karty.mnemo: Same as English 'blanket': snuggle under a red blanket by the glowing embers.

sever.priklad: Mae o'n gorwedd dan flanced ar y soffa.
sever.priklad_cs: He's lying under a blanket on the sofa (blanced → [f]lanced after dan).

karty.cs_upresneni: the luggage space of a car, not a suitcase
karty.priklad: Dw i ddim yn synnu bod cist y car yn llawn.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm not surprised the car boot is full.
karty.mnemo: CIST ≈ CHEST: a treasure chest in the boot of the car, glowing like hot coals.

karty.priklad: Beth wyt ti'n feddwl o'r gyfres newydd i ddysgwyr ar S4C?
karty.priklad_cs: What do you think of the new series for learners on S4C? (cyfres → [g]yfres after y, feminine)
karty.mnemo: rhes = a row: a series is a row of episodes, and each one ends with the red dragon breathing fire.

sever.priklad: Be wyt ti'n feddwl o'r gyfres newydd i ddysgwyr ar S4C?
sever.priklad_cs: What do you think of the new series for learners on S4C? (cyfres → [g]yfres after y, feminine)

karty.priklad: Darllenais i erthygl ddiddorol yn y papur ddoe.
karty.priklad_cs: I read an interesting article in the paper yesterday (diddorol → [dd]iddorol after the feminine erthygl).
karty.mnemo: An article about a TIGER (er-THYGL) with terrible sunburn.

karty.priklad: Mae'r tiwtor yn dweud bod y ffilm 'Marwolaeth ym Merthyr' yn dda.
karty.priklad_cs: The tutor says the film 'Death in Merthyr' is good.
karty.mnemo: marw = dead: the prize MARROW (MARW-olaeth) dies of sunburn at the village show.

sever.priklad: Mae'r tiwtor yn deud bod y ffilm 'Marwolaeth ym Merthyr' yn dda.
sever.priklad_cs: The tutor says the film 'Death in Merthyr' is good.
sever.pozn: north: deud instead of dweud (not in the coursebook)

karty.priklad_cs: What a strange situation! (rhyfedd → [r]yfedd after the feminine sefyllfa)
karty.mnemo: sefyll = to stand + -fa = place: how things stand – and right now you're standing in a sauna.

karty.priklad: Mae'n system dda, ond mae hi'n gymhleth.
karty.priklad_cs: It's a good system, but it's complicated (da → [dd]a after the feminine system; cymhleth → [g]ymhleth after yn; hi = it, because system is feminine).
karty.mnemo: Careful, feminine in Welsh! A whole system built out of red phone boxes.

karty.priklad: Gobeithio ein bod ni'n gallu mynd i'r cyngerdd ym Mae Caerdydd.
karty.priklad_cs: Hopefully we can go to the concert in Cardiff Bay (Bae → [M]ae after ym, nasal mutation).
karty.mnemo: Say BYE (BAE) to the bay – it's full of floating ice.

sever.priklad: Gobeithio ein bod ni'n medru mynd i'r cyngerdd ym Mae Caerdydd.
sever.priklad_cs: Hopefully we can go to the concert in Cardiff Bay (Bae → [M]ae after ym, nasal mutation).

karty.priklad: Mae fy nghasgliad i o bosteri'n enfawr.
karty.priklad_cs: My poster collection is huge (casgliad → [ngh]asgliad after fy, nasal; poster → [b]osteri after o).
karty.mnemo: An old CASK (CASG-liad) holds his collection of snow globes.

karty.priklad: Roedd yr awyren yn hwyr iawn yn gadael Caerdydd achos corwynt.
karty.priklad_cs: The plane was very late leaving Cardiff because of a hurricane.
karty.mnemo: gwynt = wind: a hurricane is a giant whirl of wind and hailstones.

karty.priklad: Dw i'n sicr eu bod nhw'n mynd i'r gweithdy ysgrifennu.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm sure they're going to the writing workshop.
karty.mnemo: gwaith (work) + tŷ (house): a workshop where the heating's broken and everyone works in mittens.

sever.priklad: Dw i'n sicr eu bod nhw'n mynd i'r gweithdy sgwennu.
sever.priklad_cs: I'm sure they're going to the writing workshop.
sever.pozn: north: sgwennu instead of ysgrifennu (not in the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Beth dych chi'n feddwl o'r ddrama newydd am y gwersyll heddwch ar S4C?
karty.priklad_cs: What do you think of the new drama about the peace camp on S4C?
karty.mnemo: hedd = peace; heddlu (police) = the 'peace force'. Peace at last under a soft blanket of snow.

sever.priklad: Be dach chi'n feddwl o'r ddrama newydd am y gwersyll heddwch ar S4C?
sever.priklad_cs: What do you think of the new drama about the peace camp on S4C?
sever.pozn: north: Be instead of Beth (L9), dach instead of dych (L11)

karty.priklad: Ro'n i'n meddwl bod dy boster di'n rhyfedd.
karty.priklad_cs: I thought your poster was weird (poster → [b]oster after dy).
karty.mnemo: Same as English: a poster of a blue whale.

karty.priklad: Mae rhywfaint o fara ar ôl.
karty.priklad_cs: There's a bit of bread left (bara → [f]ara after o).
karty.mnemo: rhyw (some) + maint (size) = some amount: just a few flakes of snow left on the snowman's hat.

extra.pozn: used with o + soft mutation (rhywfaint o fara)

karty.priklad: A chwympais i'n galed ar fy nhin ar yr iâ.
karty.priklad_cs: And I fell hard on my bum on the ice (tin → [nh]in after fy, nasal mutation; cwympais → [ch]wympais after a).
karty.mnemo: A TIN bum: you landed so hard on the ice it went blue.

extra.rod_pozn: the coursebook (p. 24, blue box) gives m; dictionaries (GPC) probably give f – to be checked

sever.priklad: A syrthiais i'n galed ar fy nhin ar yr iâ.
sever.priklad_cs: And I fell hard on my bum on the ice (tin → [nh]in after fy, nasal mutation).
sever.pozn: north: syrthio instead of cwympo (L14, L15)

karty.priklad: Oes gormod o drais ar y teledu?
karty.priklad_cs: Is there too much violence on TV? (trais → [d]rais after o)
karty.mnemo: In a TRICE (TRAIS) the snowball fight turns to violence.
